facts.fact: Safaricom's M-PESA processes 37 million daily person-to-person transactions worth KES 27 billion, out of 137.9 million transactions worth KES 118 billion, with Buy Goods and Paybill serving merchant payments, per TechCabal.
Transfers between M-PESA, banks and other mobile money services such as Airtel Money pass through several platforms, per TechCabal.
